message.content: Starting triage on the reported wall penetration — shrinking to the minimal failure.
Shrink isolated a fast body hitting a thin wall. I'll confirm it replays and inspect the impact.
Failure confirmed at step 4. Now tracing the approach steps to pin down the cause.
The approach shows a corner graze with unchanged velocity — testing a face-on impact as counterfactual.
Face-on impact passes, so the corner graze is the trigger — submitting the report.
